answer_2.quote: We evaluate the parser ... using Unlabeled Argument Detection (UA) and Labeled Argument Detection (LA) metrics ... Final reported numbers on labelled argument detection rates are based on ... STRICT-MATCH.

answer_4.quote: Through manual evaluation of 50 sampled predicates, we detect correctly predicted arguments and questions that were rejected by the IOU and STRICT-MATCH criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters compare predicted arguments and questions against the gold standard to assess correctness and equivalence.
